furniture_zones.label:
Orange
armchair
furniture_zones.evidence: Refit from the visible front apron, cropped back and footstool occlusion. Front faces mostly south with a small west component; the stool sits toward its front-left corner. The original nearly south-facing 0.98 m depth put the chair across the stool viewing ray. Approximate width 0.77 m, depth 0.618 m, height 1.08 m; exact hidden right edge remains uncertain. This is the orange chair, distinct from the central gold chair. Reentry: moved west with unchanged depth and facing to shift projected center left 100 pixels; visible left arm target approximately x=1520 on 1777-wide review. S1 facing-clearance repair: translate east 0.325 m without rotation. The later westward shift made its footprint overlap the stool. The photograph shows a separate stool and an orange chair cropped at the right edge, so restoring lateral separation takes precedence over the previous 100-pixel leftward preference. Full rectangular plan footprints now have more than 0.05 m clearance; stool source-center fit is retained.
